prompt: Robert's been posting technical updates in one of our engineering channels here — can you pull together everything he's written there for me to review?
binding_note: The workspace has two users named Robert: Robert Walsh, a member of #engineering, and Robert Chen, a member of #core-infra. Both channels are ordinary engineering-type channels in the single workspace, so 'Robert' plus 'engineering channel' identifies two distinct people and two distinct message sets rather than resolving to one.

roles.reason: Candidate referent set A: the Robert who is a member of #engineering.

obligations.name: robert_engineering_channel_messages
obligations.description: The messages authored by the Robert who holds conversation membership in the engineering-type channel referenced, gathered for review. Two distinct people share the first name Robert and each belongs to a different qualifying channel, giving two unresolved candidate message sets in this single workspace.
obligations.scope: messages authored by the referenced Robert within the specific engineering-focused channel where he is a conversation member, inside the shared workspace

task_spec.text: Gather the messages that Robert wrote in the engineering-type channel where he is a member, for review of his recent updates.

access_plan: Use conversations.list to enumerate channels in the single workspace, then conversations.members on #engineering and #core-infra (and other technical channels) to find members named Robert, cross-checking with users.info/users.list for the two distinct Robert identities. Use conversations.history on each qualifying channel (or search.messages) to retrieve the messages authored by the matched Robert user_id, surfacing both the #engineering set (Robert Walsh) and the #core-infra set (Robert Chen) as unresolved alternatives.
